simulation_brief.core_question: Will ordinary support for Operating System W10 end on 2025-10-14 as scheduled?
simulation_brief.summary: A vendor has a published lifecycle schedule stating ordinary support for Operating System W10 ends on 2025-10-14. Large installed base persistence, consumer advocate concerns about e-waste and security exposure, and possible government pressure create uncertainty about whether the vendor alters ordinary support before the deadline. Paid or extended security programs are explicitly distinct from ordinary support.
